name: Dunclovish
ability: Strong Jaw / Water Absorb / Swift Swim (hidden)
look: an armoured placoderm fish: a great mottled blue-grey plate over its head and shoulders, a heavy jaw, a long pale-blue body and silver-white fins
entry: The Fossilized Fish's true owner: an armoured fish whose head is one great plate of steel. Its bite could shear through the shells of anything that lived in the ancient seas.
how: Put a Dracovish or Arctovish in a CobbleEffort: Distortion DNA machine with a DNA Analyzer and a DNA Purifier beside it, pick Dunclovish at the Purifier and purify it (it keeps its level, nature and moves).
